notes: Official Einstein Bros. Nutrition Information guide (Aug 2026 edition) linked from einsteinbros.com. Coffee drinks are with 2% milk as published. Omitted: the 96 fl oz box coffee rows, the Hot Chocolate 20 fl oz row (a value missing in the source), and the second 'Caramel Macchiato, Iced' block (positioned where Vanilla Latte Iced would be; label in source is ambiguous). Doggie bagels excluded. '(licensed locations)' = airport/hospital/campus variants. Atwater outliers (kept as published): Cold Foam Topping [1 oz (28 g)] (80 cal vs Atwater 20); Turkey, Lunch [3.0 oz (85 g)] (90 cal vs Atwater 114); Cinnamon Bliss Roll [6.5 oz (185 g)] (610 cal vs Atwater 787).
